run_mapillary_evaluation: run the Mapillary dataset evaluation for a given experiment and split with recall metrics
run_mapillary_sequential: run the Mapillary evaluation in sequential mode with chunking and sequence error metrics
run_mapillary_cli: run the Mapillary evaluation CLI with --experiment flag and optional --sequential and dotlist config overrides
review_run_function: review the run function that evaluates Mapillary localization experiments and logs recall at thresholds
review_split_overrides: review the split_overrides dict that defines validation scenes for the Mapillary dataset
